description: Land Acquisition - Urubokka, Pasgoda D/S Division, Matara District and the Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 487/5 of 05.01.1988 D/S Division, Kalawana, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, names, extents, and locations) for public purposes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
